value.summary: The change adds missing API key env vars, renames the GitHub App auth vars to match what the binary actually reads, and mounts the config file read-only. No bugs are visible in the diff itself; the one claim I could not verify is whether `TINYSWEEPER_APP_ID` and `TINYSWEEPER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` are the names `server::auth::AppAuth::from_env` actually reads, since the tree search was unavailable, but there is no evidence in the diff that the names are wrong.
